title: SHL IDC Convention Decision + Opening Balance Bridge Design

blocker_1.decision: Convention B (Excel full-source elapsed compound) is authoritative for future construction runtime. Convention A is current; Convention C is the bridge.

blocker_2.summary: Layer 4 is a pure function: result + manual + policy -> bridge output + audit table. Lives in domain/construction/opening_bridge.py. Does not import the waterfall domain.

blocker_3.deferred_to: C3 or later (C2 section 5 defines the boundary only)

blocker_4.deferred_to: C3 (C2 section 6 defines the evidence required)

blocker_5.deferred_to: C3 (C2 bridge design has the senior opening balance as 'frozen' until senior IDC is modelling-correct)

files_added.rationale: Design and decision document. 7 sections: SHL IDC Convention Decision (with 3-convention comparison + recommendation), Double-Counting Policy (11 fields with replacement decisions), Opening Balance Bridge Design (Layer 4), Bridge Audit Table (14 columns), Runtime Integration Boundary (Layer 5 design-level only), Validation Requirements (6 evidence items), Recommendation (B).

convention_b_excel_engine.name: Excel full-source elapsed compound
convention_b_excel_engine.definition: SHL IDC = SHL draw * ((1 + SHL rate) ^ elapsed_years - 1)
convention_b_excel_engine.used_by: Offline construction engine only; not yet wired to waterfall

convention_c_phase7i_diagnostic.name: Phase 7I construction engine (audit-only)
convention_c_phase7i_diagnostic.definition: Same engine as Convention B, wrapped in a diagnostic-only runtime adapter
convention_c_phase7i_diagnostic.used_by: Offline engine, workbook UI (Phase 20L), senior debt diagnostic, validation notes. NOT operating waterfall.

rationale: Modelling-correctness (depends on construction period; Convention A does not)
Excel parity at the construction level (closes R-PAR-1)
Cross-project consistency (single formula, not magic numbers)
C1 already pointed here (R-PAR-1 is Critical, blocker 1)
why_not_a: Construction-period changes do not propagate to waterfall
New projects require new magic numbers

why_not_c: C is the bridge for today, not the final answer for tomorrow
Leaves operating waterfall disconnected from construction engine
migration_path: Today (A + C diagnostic): A is authoritative, C reports mismatch
C4-C6: L4 implementation + parity snapshot for TUHO
C8: TUHO promotion (A -> B; Phase 9 re-calibrated)

fields.rationale: Convention B authoritative; engine value replaces manual at COD
SHL principal draw is function of funding allocation; engine is authoritative
Senior IDC is still effective-rate based (C1 blocker 5); promote to 'replaced' after C3 demonstrates modelling correctness
Engine produces senior IDC; audit currently flags delta
Operating CAPEX total is different concept from construction CAPEX; not additive
Operating-period concept; engine does not compute
Operating-period concept; construction VAT is out of scope
Upfront at financial close, not construction-period
Runtime total is function of replaced fields; engine equity draw is construction-period equity (different concept)

replacement_semantics.replaced: construction engine output overwrites manual at seam; audit records substitution
replacement_semantics.frozen: engine output computed and reported, manual value wins; audit records disagreement
replacement_semantics.retained: engine does not produce value; manual unchanged
replacement_semantics.derived: runtime total from manual inputs; engine value is separate diagnostic

double_counting_policy.guard_invariant: Operating waterfall reads exactly one of {manual, construction-derived} for each opening balance. Choice recorded in audit trail. Reading both is a guard failure.

opening_balance_bridge_layer_4.responsibility: Produce opening balances at COD from construction result with explicit per-field decisions about whether each value is construction-derived, manual, or composite.
inputs: Replacement policy (from Layer 5 config or fixed)

outputs.capitalized_senior_idc_keur: float (zero if senior IDC not modelling-correct)

algorithm_steps: Apply per-field policy (replaced / frozen / retained / derived)
Build audit table (one row per policy field)
opening_balance_bridge_layer_4.imports_boundary: does not import waterfall, finance, project factory, or UI

invariants: Every policy field has exactly one row
selected_runtime_value is one of manual or construction (not a third number) for non-derived fields
selection_reason matches the policy (no silent override)
double_counting_guard is never not_applicable for opening balance fields
parity_reference is None for fields with no Excel target

what_layer_5_must_not_consume: ConstructionScheduleResult directly (bridge is the only legal interface)
manual override table directly (bridge has applied policy)
parity reference (test concern, not runtime concern)
what_layer_5_must_enforce: Single source per opening balance (double-counting guard)
Audit trail completeness (bridge result, version, policy, timestamp)
what_layer_5_is_not: not a policy engine (policy is fixed at bridge level)
not a parity test (parity is separate test layer)

manual_vs_derived_reconciliation_test.covers: audit table integrity, selection_reason consistency, double_counting_guard, parity_status

cod_opening_balance_reconciliation_test.covers: bridge output contains all 6 numeric fields, audit table has 11 rows, selected_runtime_value is from manual or construction for non-derived fields, bridge_metadata complete

idc_by_source_reconciliation_test.covers: capitalized_senior_idc_keur + capitalized_shl_idc_keur == total IDC (within 0.001 kEUR per source), senior IDC is 0 if effective-rate based

no_double_counting_test_plan.covers: waterfall reads exactly one of {manual, construction} for each opening balance; guard satisfied for every opening balance; composite fields derived from manual inputs
